title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Do One Thing at a Time
caption:
Most of a godly man's work day isn't stolen by his job. It's stolen by his phone. Multitasking isn't focus. It's distraction wearing a busier outfit.

Put it in another room, not another pocket. One tab, one task, one hour. Guard the first hour like it's sacred, because Colossians says whatever you do, work at it with your whole heart. Half a heart split across six tabs isn't that.

Measure the work, not the hours logged in front of it. Undivided is a work ethic, not just a virtue.
